title: 22nd September 1975
text:
Today in 1975 Abba's "Mamma Mia" entered the singles charts in Australia where it would stay for 39 weeks including an amazing 10 week run at the top of the charts. Abba's "S.O.S" and "I Do, I Do, I Do, I Do, I Do" also reached number 1 in 1975 in Australia..
